card.name: Broken bytes and starts of brand names
card.fires_on: Responds to a broken-off character piece of a symbol or to the first piece of a split drug or brand name, such as REL before ISTOR or sp before ironolactone. It also fires on stray byte pieces of non-Latin symbols.

modes.label: Broken symbol bytes
modes.description: A partial byte piece of a special symbol such as a greater-than-or-equal sign or Lao script.
